data.name: Ramkishor
data.gender_notes: Ramkishor is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ram means God and Kishor means the God of Gods. It is a combination of Rama and Kishor. The name Ramkishor carries the meaning “God of Gods” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi, Bengali. Parents who choose Ramkishor usually hope their child will grow to embody god of gods and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Ramkishor is a divine name that symbolizes the supreme power of God. It represents the ultimate truth and signifies the strength and courage of the Almighty.
data.etymology: Ramkishor belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of Gods.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ramkishor total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Ramkishor" is a significant name in Hindu culture, carrying deep respect and reverence for Lord Rama, one of the most beloved deities in Hinduism. Ram is considered an avatar (or manifestation) of the supreme Hindu god Vishnu. The name 'Ram' itself signifies strength, courage, and wisdom. The name 'Kishor' means the "god of gods" and Lord Rama is often considered as the God of Gods. Thus, the name "Ramkishor" brings to mind the divine qualities of strength, wisdom, and godliness.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Ramkishor" signifies a deep spiritual connection to the Hindu deity Lord Rama. Lord Rama is considered an embodiment of righteousness, duty, and devotion. By embracing such a name, an individual implicitly aspires to emulate these qualities in their everyday life. The name encourages the path of dharma or righteousness, and devotion to Lord Rama, which can lead to spiritual growth and enlightenment.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Ramkishor signifies the embodiment of both divine names, Rama (the ideal man, symbolizing purity, strength, and righteousness) and Kishor (youthful, energetic, and full of strength). This name represents the union of these qualities within an individual, encouraging growth in virtue and strength.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ramkishor is mentioned in the epic Ramayana as a devotee of Lord Rama The name Ramkishor carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: The name Ramkishor is associated with the Hindu deity Lord Rama and is often used in the context of devotion and worship

trends: increasing popularity in India and other countries
modern_usage.modern_context: The name Ramkishor remains relevant in modern Hindu society, representing a bridge between traditional Vedic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Hindu names.

name_in_real_life.story: A devoted individual named Priya Ramkishor in Hyderabad, India attributes much of their spiritual journey to their name Ramkishor, which means "God of Gods". They believe their name has guided them on the path of righteousness.
